crush_condition: Zone B >= 5.0 p/m² for >= 2 consecutive minutes
note: Synthetic model-based simulation, not real-world validation.

late.label: Late action – approve crowd-control only after crush conditions start

advised.label: NERISAL advised – approve crowd-control 1 minute after it is raised

headline: In 200 simulated rallies, acting on NERISAL's first warnings kept Zone B out of crush conditions in 73 % of runs vs 0 % with no action.
headline_preventable: 51 runs were already at crush density when monitoring began (no warning can prevent those). In the other 149: 98 % stayed safe with NERISAL advice vs 0 % with no action.
